description: This file contains Java unit tests for validating XML configuration files against a DTD, specifically focusing on the ModuleConfigDTD version 1.4. It uses JUnit 5 parameterized tests to check various scenarios of configuration XML validity.

classes.name: ModuleConfigDTDTest_V1_4
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating XML configuration files against the ModuleConfig DTD version 1.4, including multiple test cases using parameterized tests.

methods.name: validXmlWithMultipleAwareOfModules
methods.description: Tests that a valid XML configuration with multiple 'awareOfModules' entries is recognized as valid by the DTD validator.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a DOM Document object to its String XML representation.

methods.name: validXmlWithMissingVersion
methods.description: Checks that an XML configuration missing the 'version' attribute is still considered valid.

methods.name: xmlFailsWithNoModules
methods.description: Verifies that an XML configuration with no 'awareOfModules' entries fails validation.

methods.name: getCompatibleVersions
methods.description: Provides a stream of version arguments for parameterized tests.
